# TASK-611: Classify projects and their output directories

## Goal

Detect project roots from repository and manifest markers, then classify their known output directories as objects using git ignore and git tracking where a repository exists and manifest-anchored rules where it does not. Only the outermost match becomes an object; a tracked directory is never one.

## Deliverables

- Classification engine with stated confidence and reasons
- Regression suite and mutation evidence
